QuestInfo.name: OSSS Mission 2: Protecting the Scientists
QuestInfo.1: Protect two scientists hard at work throughout Maple World. When you find a scientist and start a conversation, aliens will appear. You must protect the scientists. You will not be able to do the mission when another Mapler is protecting the scientist.
QuestInfo.2: Receive this mission again after completing the other missions.

0.0: You've been issued a special mission from the OSSS. You can complete it if you have the #b#t4032715##k.

yes.0: I see that you have the #b#t4032715##k. I will issue you Mission 2.
yes.1: As I'm sure you are already aware, scientists throughout Maple World are being abducted by alien motherships.
yes.2: Please locate the scientists and protect them!
yes.3: You will get a medal every time you protect two scientists and keep them safe. You will get a medal when you complete the mission. Talk to #b#p9250135##k to upgrade your suit using those medals.

no.0: Idle chat can wait until after you've saved Maple World...

yes.0: Thank you for your work. Here is your medal. Head over to #b#p9250135##k to purchase various cells that can be used to upgrade your suit.

default.0: Looks like you haven't finished the mission just yet...
